{{Short description|Toolkit to support Rubin causal modeling of observational data}}
{{other uses}}

'''TWANG''', the Toolkit for Weighting and Analysis of Nonequivalent Groups, developed by the statistics group of the [[RAND Corporation]], contains a set of functions to support [[Rubin causal model]]ing of [[observational data]] through the estimation and evaluation of [[propensity score]] weights by applying [[gradient boosting]]. It has been applied in several studies.<ref>{{cite journal | pmc=3965689 | date=2014 | last1=Schuler | first1=M. S. | last2=Griffin | first2=B.
